defect_observations.observation: Queue snapshot is stale against the live body (live sha256 714B8F45..., queue and packet w02b-p15-004 record 8C4D7DCE...): body_lines for C018/C019/C020 are now 378-407, 409-424, 426-444 (queue: 378-405, 407-422, 424-435), and exact_current_text for C018 and C020 no longer matches the live text. This audit assessed the live text only.

Durrett's separate direct quadratic-discriminant proof of Cauchy-Schwarz (Remark, printed p. 26) is not reproduced; Cauchy-Schwarz appears only as the p=q=2 case of Hoelder. Not judged a gap because the entry's own statement and declared proof are complete and the scope notes were not opened.

Durrett's displayed special case (1.6.1), a^2 P(|X|>=a) <= EX^2 (printed p. 30), is not displayed; the handbook's 'variance form' is the centred version. (1.6.1) follows at once from the general bound with phi(x)=x^2, and the naming note about Durrett is accurate.
Durrett also calls the constant-dominator special case of dominated convergence 'the bounded convergence theorem' (printed p. 30). The handbook states the case but not that second use of the name.

Proof route is reversed from the source: Durrett proves Fatou from bounded convergence and Lemma 1.4.4, then monotone convergence from Fatou (printed pp. 26-27). The handbook proves MCT directly and Fatou from MCT; the introduction (body lines 13-15) announces the direct MCT route but does not describe Durrett's route.

The proof boundary says nothing about the source items inside the cited pp. 18-37 that appear neither in this chapter nor at its pointer targets: Exercises 1.5.5, 1.5.8, 1.5.10 and 1.6.1-1.6.14, Example 1.6.12 (Bernoulli), and the special-case notations (a)-(d) on printed pp. 23-24. Whether these fall in the selected extent depends on the scope notes, which this audit did not open, so they are not counted against the entry's own promise.
Divergence of sum 1/(k+1) is justified by a one-sentence dyadic-block argument that gives no explicit block bound (each block is at least 1/2). The argument is compressed but logically complete.
'The proof below' refers to the Jensen proof in Appendix P (annex lines 359-389), not to a proof in the body. This is a wording issue only.

The proofs of the trap bounds and limits are forward references to a later chapter (thm:p15-w02b-p15-001-uniform-moments, input after this chapter). That proof uses only earlier results and the entries of this chapter, so it is not circular.
